output.reason: One month of sleep-onset difficulty during work stress with preserved function and no reported red-flag features can start with sleep-habit measures and guidance, with review if it persists or worsens.
output.patientMessage: You can start now with sleep-habit steps: consistent bed and wake times, no caffeine after midday, no screens in bed, wind-down routine, and get up to do something calming if you can't sleep after about 20 minutes. Stress-related sleep-onset trouble often improves this way. Message us in this thread if sleep is no worse after 3–4 weeks, or sooner if low mood, hopelessness, thoughts of self-harm, or drowsiness while driving appear.
